title: Interrupted time series: segmented regression with Newey-West errors
summary: Level and slope changes at an intervention date in a single monthly series, with autocorrelation-robust standard errors at a stated lag.
pinned_defaults: Both: rate ~ month + post + months_since by OLS: pre-trend, level change, slope change.

Both: Newey-West covariance at lag 3, Bartlett weights, no pre-whitening, no small-sample adjustment (sandwich::NeweyWest(lag = 3, prewhite = FALSE, adjust = FALSE); statsmodels HAC with use_correction = False). NeweyWest's own defaults pre-whiten and choose the lag from the data.
_seasonality: This fixture has no seasonal cycle. A real monthly series usually does and needs seasonal terms; and with fewer than about 8 points on a side the trends are not estimable.
